annotations.title: Look up property owners of record from county tax rolls

description: Give US street addresses, or a state (NC, NY, FL, CO, AR, WI) with parcel IDs, owner names, or ZIP codes. Returns one row per parcel from public county tax rolls with the owner of record, the tax roll mailing address, property address, assessed and market values, land use, and last sale where published. No phone numbers or emails. Misses are free. Pay per event on Apify: 0.02 USD per parcel row.

addresses.description: Full US street addresses with city and state, one per entry, such as 1 E Edenton St, Raleigh, NC 27601. The US Census geocoder places each one and the actor returns the parcel at that point. The state comes from the address, so the state field is not needed. An address it cannot place, or one outside the covered states, is a free row.

county.description: Optional county name, such as Wake or St. Lawrence, to narrow parcel_ids, owner_names, and zip_codes. Does not apply to addresses.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

max_results_per_lookup.description: Parcel rows per address, parcel ID, owner name, or ZIP, from 1 to 5000. Default 25.

owner_match.description: starts_with (default): the owner name starts with your text. contains: the text appears anywhere in the name; slower, so add a county.

owner_names.description: Owner names as the roll writes them, usually last name first for a person (SMITH JOHN) and the full name for a company (CITY OF RALEIGH). Needs state. Matches names that start with the text unless owner_match is contains.

parcel_ids.description: Parcel numbers as the county writes them. Needs state. Add county, because the same number can repeat in two counties.

state.description: Two letter state for parcel_ids, owner_names, and zip_codes: NC, NY, FL, CO, AR, or WI.

zip_codes.description: 5 digit property ZIP codes. Returns every parcel in the ZIP up to max_results_per_lookup. Needs state.

name: lookup_property_owner_records
title: Look up property owners of record from county tax rolls
